blocks.text: This section discusses four types of UML diagram.

blocks.caption: Four UML diagrams in this chapter
rows: actors and the goals (use cases) they reach with the system
classes, their attributes and methods, and how they are related
messages passed between objects in time order
the flow of steps and decisions in a process
